title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：procedure　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 procedure 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the clerk ① followed the procedure that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the following was the whole of the month. The ② procedure, meaning the process itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a procedure, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ procedure in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ procedure at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A procedure, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the procedure was the whole of the matter, meaning the rule and not the process. The ⑥ procedure, meaning the rule and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; procedure, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both a process and a rule. He said the rule is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ procedure had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ procedure of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; procedure, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ procedure I remember is the process recorded in the file, which closed in 1998 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ procedure, my mother said in 2000, is the only process that improves by being recorded; every procedure, she said, is a rule that has agreed to look like a process. She said the rule was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 程序；步骤（指办事处里每一道旁边的那一道）
B. n. 程序；步骤（指那道程序本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow the procedure 依这一道程序
D. n. 程序；步骤（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 程序之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的程序之事）
F. n. 程序；步骤（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一道）
G. n. 程序、规矩（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 规矩（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: followed the procedure that no applicant in the office would have recorded
The procedure, meaning the process itself and not the stamp
the procedure at the far counter
the procedure was the whole of the matter

The procedure of the whole thing

answers.why: follow the procedure 意为“依这一道程序”，1991 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一道程序做了一遍。
procedure 意为“程序；步骤”，指那道程序本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
procedure 意为“程序；步骤”，指办事处里每一道旁边的那一道，每一道旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
procedure 意为“程序；步骤”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
procedure 意为“程序、规矩”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道规矩就是那件事的全部。
procedure 意为“规矩”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那道程序，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
procedure 意为“程序；步骤”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一道，到 1996 年这一道成了卷宗里的一行。
procedure 意为“程序之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的程序之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
procedure 意为“程序；步骤”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一道，1998 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一道。
procedure 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，程序是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的程序。
